subject: HARMONY / Pattern Harmony plan acceptance coverage
scope: H-01 through H-07 and PH-01 through PH-04; MM-08+ remains outside this delivery
layer_policy: Player-visible controls, MIDI, screen, grid and persistence use the emulator public input/output path. Finite solver spaces and high-cardinality interaction products use independent unit or integration oracles where repeating the same state through thousands of UI gestures would add runtime rather than confidence.
